name: ICS / GEO Tools: Experiment 4/4B Metric Replay and GoalProgress Stress Benchmark
description: Apache-2.0 research software for ICS / GEO. It replays the stored CEI, CEI-4B, ranking, and aggregate metric layer of ICS v3 Experiments 4 and 4B, and runs the GoalProgress repair through independent deterministic synthetic benchmarks. The package includes the replay and stress-benchmark source, contract notes for experiments 4/4B, AP-CERT-0, and GEO-F2R through F2R3, the archived experiment fixtures, validation outputs, release checksums, and the test suite. A preregistered reliability sweep is included, with the failed zero-signal condition that came from correlated-feature leakage.
